name: How do you choose sustainable building materials?

mainEntity.name: How do you choose sustainable building materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prioritize locally sourced, recycled content, low-VOC, FSC-certified wood, rapidly renewable materials, and products with high recycled content or Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs). wbdg​
